paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of data entries across different task categories. The dataset primarily consists of Math (29.3%), Coding (24.3%), and Information Seeking (22.2%) tasks, followed by Reasoning (10.4%), Planning (2.3%), Creative Writing (2.2%), and other combined categories (9.3%).
model_annotation: The pie chart displays the distribution of data entries across different task categories. The chart is divided into eight slices, each representing a distinct category. The categories and their corresponding proportions are as follows: Math, colored red, accounts for 29.3%; Coding, colored blue, accounts for 24.3%; Information Seeking, colored green, accounts for 22.2%; Reasoning, colored orange, accounts for 10.4%; Others (combined), colored light green, accounts for 9.3%; Creative Writing, colored pink, accounts for 2.2%; Planning, colored purple, accounts for 2.3%. The chart includes a legend that matches the color of each slice to its respective category. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice, Math, positioned at the top left and the smallest slices, Creative Writing and Planning, positioned near the bottom center. The percentages are labeled inside or next to each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized beyond their size and color representation.
